name: Axel Svenson
source: Axel is Lena's ex-boyfriend. They met through Ivy, and both of them got Lena into the modeling world. He makes a living both as a model and photographer, though he claims to be more interested in being behind a camera rather than in front of one. His magnetic and dominant personality has granted him a lot of success, but that doesn't seem to be enough to make him happy.
